N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

N_medical_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a medical vaccination exemption
N_medical_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
N_medical_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

nj_school_immunization.name: New Jersey School Immunization Status
nj_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization and exemption data from the NJDOH immunization status reports.
nj_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
